\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 223-226 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R231-first-pass-words-from-chapters-223-226}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a pharmacy and a nurse.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to tidy, to sweep, to iron, to fold, to hang
  \item to earn, to borrow, to lend, to change, to hurry
  \item to pull; to withdraw, to prepare, to repair, to use, to bring
  \item to set off, to charge, to apologise, to inform, to agree
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To tidy? (\textbf{\ar{رتب}}, \emph{rattaba}.) To sweep? (\textbf{\ar{كنس}}, \emph{kanasa}.) To iron? (\textbf{\ar{كوى}}, \emph{kawā}.) To fold? (\textbf{\ar{طوى}}, \emph{ṭawā}.) To hang? (\textbf{\ar{علق}}, \emph{ʿallaqa}.) To earn? (\textbf{\ar{كسب}}, \emph{kasaba}.) To borrow? (\textbf{\ar{اقترض}}, \emph{iqtaraḍa}.) To lend? (\textbf{\ar{أقرض}}, \emph{aqraḍa}.) To change? (\textbf{\ar{غير}}, \emph{ghayyara}.) To hurry? (\textbf{\ar{أسرع}}, \emph{asraʿa}.) To pull; to withdraw? (\textbf{\ar{سحب}}, \emph{saḥaba}.) To prepare? (\textbf{\ar{حضر}}, \emph{ḥaḍḍara}.) To repair? (\textbf{\ar{أصلح}}, \emph{aṣlaḥa}.) To use? (\textbf{\ar{استعمل}}, \emph{istaʿmala}.) To bring? (\textbf{\ar{أحضر}}, \emph{aḥḍara}.) To set off? (\textbf{\ar{انطلق}}, \emph{inṭalaqa}.) To charge? (\textbf{\ar{شحن}}, \emph{shaḥana}.) To apologise? (\textbf{\ar{اعتذر}}, \emph{iʿtadhara}.) To inform? (\textbf{\ar{أخبر}}, \emph{akhbara}.) To agree? (\textbf{\ar{اتفق}}, \emph{ittafaqa}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 227-231 — a second pass}

  \item to watch, to listen, to draw, to sing, to photograph
  \item to tie, to untie, to water, to knead, to wipe
  \item to bark, to feed, to add, to divide, to kick
  \item treatment, a prescription; a recipe, a clinic, a pharmacy, a nurse

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To be shy? (\textbf{\ar{خجل}}, \emph{khajila}.) To worry? (\textbf{\ar{قلق}}, \emph{qaliqa}.) To get to know? (\textbf{\ar{تعرف}}, \emph{taʿarrafa}.) To quarrel? (\textbf{\ar{تشاجر}}, \emph{tashājara}.) To make up? (\textbf{\ar{تصالح}}, \emph{taṣālaḥa}.) To watch? (\textbf{\ar{شاهد}}, \emph{shāhada}.) To listen? (\textbf{\ar{استمع}}, \emph{istamaʿa}.) To draw? (\textbf{\ar{رسم}}, \emph{rasama}.) To sing? (\textbf{\ar{غنى}}, \emph{ghannā}.) To photograph? (\textbf{\ar{صور}}, \emph{ṣawwara}.) To tie? (\textbf{\ar{ربط}}, \emph{rabaṭa}.) To untie? (\textbf{\ar{فك}}, \emph{fakka}.) To water? (\textbf{\ar{سقى}}, \emph{saqā}.) To knead? (\textbf{\ar{عجن}}, \emph{ʿajana}.) To wipe? (\textbf{\ar{مسح}}, \emph{masaḥa}.) To bark? (\textbf{\ar{نبح}}, \emph{nabaḥa}.) To feed? (\textbf{\ar{أطعم}}, \emph{aṭʿama}.) To add? (\textbf{\ar{أضاف}}, \emph{aḍāfa}.) To divide? (\textbf{\ar{قسم}}, \emph{qassama}.) To kick? (\textbf{\ar{ركل}}, \emph{rakala}.) Treatment? (\textbf{\ar{علاج}}, \emph{ʿilāj}.) A prescription; a recipe? (\textbf{\ar{وصفة}}, \emph{waṣfa}.) A clinic? (\textbf{\ar{عيادة}}, \emph{ʿiyāda}.) A pharmacy? (\textbf{\ar{صيدلية}}, \emph{ṣaydaliyya}.) A nurse? (\textbf{\ar{ممرض}}, \emph{mumarriḍ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
